main.description: What a public board was when it closed and what it came to, signed by the custody key: the statement a tally is official by, and what anyone's recount is checked against. The signature is ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256 of these lines of text after the line `wiki-poll-closeout-v1`: pollId, entries, issued, counts joined by commas, boardDigest, closedAt (`crates/ballot-spec/src/custody.rs`). `wiki-board-mirror check` verifies it against its own copy of the board.

poll.description: The announcement, by its address alone: closing it changed its CID.

issued.description: Unit tokens handed out: the bound on `entries` that anyone can check.

boardDigest.description: SHA-256, in hex, over the entries' digests in token order: the same board in whatever order it was cast, published or read.

key.description: The custody key, as the announcement named it.
